mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} ORDER BY ingredient_id,menu_id

SELECT b.*,p.product_name product_name_snapshot FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=b.account_id AND ap.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id} AND ap.mapped_ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY b.created_at,b.inventory_balance_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance SET average_unit_cost=CASE WHEN current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}=0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(inventory_amount+#{amount_delta},0)/(current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}) END, inventory_amount=CASE WHEN current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}=0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(inventory_amount+#{amount_delta},0) END, current_base_qty=current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta},last_movement_at=NOW(),user_id=#{user_id} WHERE inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} AND current_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}>=0

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot SET remaining_base_qty=remaining_base_qty+#{quantity_delta}, status=CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','CONSUMED') THEN status WHEN remaining_base_qty=0 THEN 'CONSUMED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END WHERE inventory_lot_id=#{inventory_lot_id} AND account_id=#{account_id} AND remaining_base_qty+#{quantity_delta} BETWEEN 0 AND received_base_qty
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage WHERE meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND reversed_at IS NULL ORDER BY inventory_balance_id,usage_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage SET reversed_at=NOW() WHERE usage_id=#{usage_id} AND reversed_at IS NULL

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=( SELECT so.supplier_offer_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer so JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.supplier_account_site_id=so.supplier_account_site_id WHERE ss.account_id=ms.account_id AND ss.active_yn='Y' AND so.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id AND so.active_yn='Y' AND (so.valid_from IS NULL OR so.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE) AND (so.valid_to IS NULL OR so.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY so.last_synced_at DESC,so.supplier_offer_id DESC LIMIT 1) SET r.product_name_snapshot=COALESCE(p.product_name,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw),r.origin_name_snapshot= WHERE r.meal_service_id=#{meal_service_id} AND r.origin_name_snapshot IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id,COALESCE(r.product_name_snapshot,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, COALESCE(r.origin_name_snapshot,'원산지 미확인 (보존 기록 없음)') origin_name,'SAVED' origin_source,ms.meal_service_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} AND ms.status<>'COMPLETED' UNION ALL SELECT u.menu_id,u.ingredient_id,u.product_name_snapshot,u.origin_name_snapshot,'ACTUAL',ms.meal_service_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage u JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=u.meal_service_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} AND u.reversed_at IS NULL AND ms.status='COMPLETED'
